Create one complete wide 16:9 side-view 2D fighting-game arena environment. Rich detailed arcade PIXEL ART with deliberate sharp stepped clusters, 2-3 tone material shading, controlled dithering, rich limited palette, detailed craftsmanship at an approximately 640x360 pixel working scale. No smooth painting, no 3D render, no photographic texture or blur. Preserve the original reference environment identity. Fixed horizontal camera at fighter height. Flat walkable fighting lane spanning every pixel of the width, foot contact line at 80.3 percent image height (y=578 in a 1280x720 game). Foreground continues to bottom, no raised props, fences, bushes, crystal clusters or pits in front of fighters. Keep central combat area x=80..1200, y=350..600 low contrast and unobstructed. Put dense material detail in middle/far background and side framing behind lane. Top 22 percent subdued for HUD. No characters, people, units, creatures, portraits, text, letters, badges, panels, logos, watermarks, UI or HUD. No reference screenshot overlays. Detail should describe architecture and terrain, not random visual noise.

HATCHERY: Use original environment screenshot as primary identity reference, existing side-view image only for camera and arena staging. Dark charcoal/navy octagonal alien courtyard and indigo-purple organic creep. Monumental CENTRAL organic hatchery behind the fighting lane: intricate rust-brown segmented chitin ribs, asymmetrical tall curled blade/horn fins, orange-red fleshy core, vivid yellow/lime armor sacs. Increase fidelity of the hatchery structure: layered armor plates, ridged carapace, recessed warm fissures, tendon roots and egg chambers. Layered gothic perimeter walls with tiny cyan inset lamps, jagged icy blue mineral clusters, ochre/gold incubating pods, far shadowed hive spires and bridges. Crisp mineral facets, worn carved masonry, luminous membranes, and purple growth veins, all with intentional pixel clusters. Keep the ground beneath fighters restrained; concentrate bright detail on the central hive and distant crystals. Central hatchery is an alien building, no eyes, face or humanoid anatomy. Deep midnight atmosphere with localized blue and yellow light, no global bloom. Avoid adding foreground crystals at bottom corners.
